ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure is triangle ABC, A is at the lower left, B is at the lower right, and C is above. There is a right-angle mark at point C, so this is a right triangle with C as the right angle. Side AC is labeled 24, side BC is labeled 10, and base AB is labeled 26; since the right angle is at C, the opposite side AB is the hypotenuse. Reasoning: The problem asks to convert the ratio of sin B into a decimal and round to the hundredths place. For angle B, sine equals the opposite side divided by the hypotenuse.
